beat.boundaryReason: The session opens with separate arrival vignettes for the four characters and closes this introductory movement just before they converge on the disturbance in town.
dateEvidence: The manifest starts the session on 1748-03-21.

beat.title: Tracks into the Badlands
beat.boundaryReason: The party leaves Karawa, follows the attackers northeast into the canyonlands, loses the trail, and climbs to a vantage where a distant dust cloud offers a new lead.
dateEvidence: The party departs after the same morning's attack and several hours of tracking pass.
The DM explicitly places the party in the early afternoon sun near the end of the beat.

The transcript explicitly narrates a cold night, a long rest, and a pre-dawn departure on the following day.
